_comment: RisingWave consumes the postgres dialect of the corpus (it speaks pgwire), and the
adapter strips the length/precision type parameters its parser rejects and gives each
view an explicit positional column list — a corpus query that does SELECT * over a
join otherwise fails with 'column "w_id" specified more than once'. Both are SQL
Classification is constant: a MATERIALIZED VIEW is a streaming dataflow, so a query
the planner accepts is maintained incrementally and one it rejects is not maintained
at all. The informative number is the acceptance rate.
The smoke row runs first so a dialect or connection problem surfaces in minutes
rather than after the full corpus.
